name: QUBO Benchmark Suite
description: Benchmark suite for Quadratic Unconstrained Binary Optimization (QUBO), the standard formulation for mapping combinatorial problems onto quantum hardware. Compares quantum solvers (D-Wave Hybrid Solver, gate-based QAOA) against quantum-inspired solvers (Toshiba SBM, Fujitsu Digital Annealer) and classical heuristics on established instance libraries including MQLib, random NAE 3-SAT, and Sherrington-Kirkpatrick models.
hardware: D-Wave, Fujitsu Digital Annealer, Toshiba SBM

sources.title: Benchmark of quantum-inspired heuristic solvers for quadratic unconstrained binary optimization
